# flutter_fiber

> Declarative 3D for Flutter. Native, no WebView, no bundled engine. A three.js port with PBR materials, glTF loading, clearcoat, hemisphere lights and procedural sky.

## Docs
- [Home / Quick start](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/)
- [glTF / GLB models](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/gltf)
- [Materials](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/materials)
- [Clearcoat](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/clearcoat)
- [Hemisphere light](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/hemisphere-light)
- [Vertex colors](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/vertex-colors)
- [Photo in shape](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/photo-in-shape)
- [Lottie in shape](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/lottie-in-shape)
- [Text in shape](https://flutter-fiber-docs.vercel.app/guides/text-in-shape)
